claim: Damme lies about 6 km northeast of Bruges via a flat, straight, tree-lined canal cycling path, roughly 20-25 minutes by bike.
quote: Damme is located 6 kilometers (approximately 20 minutes) northeast of Bruges by bicycle. The route is described as mostly straight, easy and flat making it nearly impossible to get lost.

claim: The Lamme Goedzak paddle steamer sails four times daily between Bruges (Noorweegse Kaai 31) and Damme (Damse Vaart Zuid 21).
quote: The boat sails back and forth four times a day between Bruges and the centre of Damme... Bruges: Noorweegse Kaai 31; Damme: Damse Vaart Zuid 21. Single trip (adults/children 12+): EUR 12.00; Round trip: EUR 18.00; Children under 12: EUR 4.00 / EUR 7.00.

claim: In 2026 De Lamme Goedzak runs daily from 4 April to 4 October, then weekends only through 1 November, with departures from Bruges at 12:00/14:00/16:00/18:00 and from Damme at 11:00/13:00/15:00/17:00.
quote: De Lamme Goedzak operates daily from April 4 to October 4, 2026 between 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM. After October 4, it operates only on weekends until November 1, 2026.

claim: Damme has positioned itself as Flanders' book village since the 1990s, with picturesque second-hand bookshops including Diogenes, Maerlant and Feniks, and a themed book-and-art market on the second Sunday of every month.
quote: A themed book and art market occurs every second Sunday of the month in Damme... Three specific establishments are mentioned: Boeken Diogenes, Boekhandel Maerlant, and Feniks.

claim: The Uilenspiegelmuseum tells the centuries-old story of Tijl Uilenspiegel through medieval manuscripts, 16th-century prints, bibliophile editions, engravings and interactive installations.
quote: The Uilenspiegel museum reveals the story and centuries-old history of Tijl Uilenspiegel, displaying medieval manuscripts, 16th-century prints, bibliophile editions, engravings, sculptures, and interactive installations.

claim: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk dates to 1225 and visitors can climb its tower for an impressive view across town and out to the Zwin region.
quote: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk (Church of Our Lady): A 15th-century church featuring a steep climb to the tower offering an impressive view of the city and the Zwin region.

claim: Damme's Gothic Stadhuis was built 1464-1468, with facade figures of Philip of Alsace, Charles the Bold and Margaret of York, and two medieval punishment stones on its corner.
quote: The Stadhuis of Damme was built between 1464 and 1468... The stone figures on the facade represent Philip of Alsace, Johanna and Margaret of Constantinople, Philip of Thiette, Charles the Bold and Margaret of York. On the corner you can see two punishment stones.

claim: Damme is encircled by a distinctive star-shaped moat and rampart system with tree-lined walking paths and meadows, a remnant of its 17th-century defensive works.
quote: Star-Fort Moat - The town is encircled by a distinctive star-shaped water defense system with tree-lined walking paths and pastoral meadows.

claim: Tante Marie at Kerkstraat 38 is a popular bike-friendly cafe-patisserie-restaurant serving lunch, homemade shrimp croquettes, pastries and 40+ coffees/teas.
quote: Tante Marie is located in the heart of the historic town of Damme... bike-friendly eatery with a private parking lot for around ten cars and a bicycle shed... no less than forty different varieties.

claim: The Damse Vaart canal towpath, lined with stately rows of poplars passing windmills and polder farmland, is the classic flat, scenic ride into Damme from Bruges.
quote: follows a straight line of poplar trees along the Damse Vaart, past windmills and farmland, to one of Flanders' most charming small towns. The cycle path is perfectly flat and well-paved, running parallel to the water.

claim: Damme owes its Uilenspiegel identity to Charles De Coster's novel which set the legend's adventures in the town, complemented by statues of Jacob van Maerlant and Tijl on the Markt.
quote: Charles De Coster set his novel about Tyl Owlglass in Damme, further cementing the town's cultural identity... Jacob van Maerlant statue, the Memorial of Tyll Owlglass, and the Monument of Tyll Owlglass.
